observed_root_causes: R152 plasma quad never read uControls.x (style), so the 4 named presets only altered supplemental particle positions; plasma material remained identical.
R152 internal arcs originated close to the center, with widely-jittered isolated beads and insufficient continuous thin stroke appearance.
R152 cloud/filament blending had insufficiently differentiated depth zones.
changes: Main plasma quad now switches among explicit plasma, electrical, ion vortex and core fusion procedural fields; default plasma uses domain-warped 3D noise, narrow luminous filaments, dark channels and a compact corona.
Emission slider now modulates brightness of volumetric filaments while core radius and core flux remain independent.
Electrical lightning 30-bead paths launch from reproducible scattered origins across inner volume and animate with short coherent zigzags and stochastic forks.
Point sprite radiance elongates in path direction but becomes tighter transversely; avoids liquid/thick lightning.
No additional controls: 16 existing native controls preserved, single WebGL1 program, old marble removed, original white/cyan/royal/violet palette retained.
